description:
About Our Brand and Products

PuckiPuppy is a California-based electric bike brand inspired by the joyful companionship between our founder Bob and his adventurous puppy, Pudding. We specialize in powerful and comfortable motorized tricycles and ebikes designed to make every ride feel like an adventure with a loyal companion by your side. From full-suspension comfort to innovative design, our products are built for riders who value freedom, stability, and fun.

What Makes Us Different

Just like a puppy that’s always by your side, PuckiPuppy is about connection, joy, and reliable companionship. Our brand brings together emotion and engineering — blending rider-centric design, eco-conscious values, and community spirit. Every model is crafted to encourage people to embrace an active, sustainable lifestyle with comfort and confidence. Our slogan, "Keep Turning," reflects our drive for constant movement, growth, and exploration.

How Affiliates Can Earn

Affiliates earn commissions starting at 5% per sale, with opportunities to grow based on performance. With an average order value of around $1,500, even a few conversions can generate meaningful income. As your total referred sales increase, you’ll also unlock higher commission tiers and exclusive affiliate benefits.

How to Promote Us

Affiliates can promote PuckiPuppy through blogs, YouTube channels, review articles, social media, email marketing, and more. Whether you're an adventure content creator, tech reviewer, or lifestyle influencer, we welcome creative, authentic ways of showcasing our bikes and community values. We’re happy to provide custom assets, tracking tools, and tailored support to help you succeed.

Other Information

We are actively building a rider community and love partnering with affiliates who share our passion for the outdoors, pets, and freedom of movement. We also take pride in our commitment to environmental sustainability and innovation. Join us in spreading joy, one ride at a time.


If you have any questions, please feel free to contact marketing@puckipuppy.com
payout_period: Approved commissions are paid during the last week of each month. For example, most commissions generated in June will be paid out in the last week of July.
